purpose: Document first-party local cadastral/registry evidence and bounded anonymous geometry access review.
assessment: Official process requires an applicant to present proof of land ownership to a licensed surveyor, pay fees, then obtain an approved survey plan; verified record copy is retained by the Surveyor General. Public government services describe land certificate, title search, and survey services but expose no map API.
registryAssessment: Ondo State Government Office of the Surveyor General guidelines name the Ministry of Lands and Housing as the authority, list an Ondo Area Lands Office in Ondo town, and say the Ministry retains the survey-plan record copy. This is specific local-custodian evidence.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Ondo State Government Ministry of Land and Housing, Office of the Surveyor General guidelines name an Ondo Area Lands Office on Ademulegun Road; plans are submitted for verification and a record copy is retained by the Office of the Surveyor General.
